title: Weighted kappa
description: Weighted Cohen kappa for two numeric raters, with linear or quadratic disagreement weights.

subject_dim.title: Subject dimension
subject_dim.description: Name of the subject dimension in the ratings table.

rater_dim.title: Rater dimension
rater_dim.description: Name of the rater dimension; exactly two raters are required.

weights.title: Disagreement weights
weights.description: Linear weights penalize disagreement in proportion to the rating gap; quadratic weights penalize its square.
